exemptionReasons.credentialed-dev-database-integration: Requires owner-approved test-environment credentials and writes fixture data through the live Supabase service boundary; normal source CI has neither that credential handoff nor an isolated database lifecycle.
exemptionReasons.real-time-acp-admission: Runs a separate ACP process against the unchanged 60-second admission deadline and a real 90-second compaction. This manual acceptance fixture deliberately uses real time; acp-v2.test.ts covers the same state transitions with virtual clocks in CI, and the short idle/exit child-process cases also run in the unit suite. Run with pnpm exec vitest run --project gugu-integration tests/integration/desktop/acpCompactionAdmission.test.ts.
